'''Kevin Howard''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (17 February)]] on 17 February 2001 with Carbonite Chamber/IAO start, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1739">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1739/ pleasanton-ca-2-17-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 18 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1739/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
